post_title: How many cumulative confirmed measles cases will Mexico's daily measles bulletin report on November 26, 2026?

question.title: How many cumulative confirmed measles cases will Mexico's daily measles bulletin report on November 26, 2026?
question.description:
Mexico has been in a sustained measles outbreak since February 2025. In the bulletin dated 11 November 2026 (data cut-off 11:00 hrs local time), the Secretaría de Salud reported 20,552 confirmed measles cases for 2025–2026 combined (2025: 6,614; 2026: 13,938), 50 confirmed deaths (27 in 2025, 23 in 2026) across 12 states, and transmission in all 32 states and 531 municipios — 21 consecutive months of transmission. The same edition shows 46,582 notified febrile exanthematous illness (EFE) cases, 25,120 discarded, 910 still under study, and 0 confirmed rubella cases.

SOURCE: the Dirección General de Epidemiología publishes a dated daily PDF bulletin on weekdays (Monday–Friday), indexed at https://www.gob.mx/salud/documentos/informe-diario-del-brote-de-sarampion-en-mexico-2026, each carrying a data cut-off of 11:00 hrs on its own date. The number to read appears both in the headline sentence ("se han notificado … casos de EFE, de los cuales se han confirmado a sarampión 20,552") and in the "Total casos confirmados acumulados 2025-2026" column of the state table.

RECENT TRAJECTORY of the cumulative confirmed total: 20,332 (19 Oct), 20,375 (26 Oct), 20,410 (5 Nov), 20,552 (11 Nov) — growth of roughly 3.5 to 24 newly confirmed cases per day. Deaths have been flat at 50 since at least 19 October (they were 49 on 25 September), so it is case classification, not mortality, that moves this number.

WHY IT JUMPS: since 4 September 2026 the ministry has been carrying out a "final classification" strategy for previously pending cases, prompted by a PAHO commission visit, which produces batch increments rather than smooth daily additions; for example, the 5 November bulletin confirmed 23 cases from earlier weeks (Jalisco 18, Chiapas 5) while confirming no newly reported same-day cases, and noted that daily confirmed counts may show such jumps. Roughly 900–1,100 cases sit under study at any time, and about 44% of notified EFE cases have ultimately been laboratory-confirmed, so further batch confirmations are plausible over the coming fortnight. Meanwhile new transmission appears to be fading: recent weekly EFE notifications were in the single digits to low twenties, and Mexico City has gone about 10 weeks without active cases.

CONTEXT: PAHO reviewed Mexico's measles elimination status on 10–13 November 2026, and its regional situation report #15 (data through epidemiological week 43) listed Mexico at 13,761 confirmed 2026 cases and 23 deaths. The forecast therefore hinges on how quickly the remaining backlog of under-study cases is adjudicated into confirmed cases between mid-November and the bulletin dated 26 November 2026.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the cumulative number of confirmed measles cases for 2025–2026 ("Total casos confirmados acumulados 2025-2026") stated in Mexico's Secretaría de Salud daily measles bulletin ("Informe Diario de Sarampión"), as listed at https://www.gob.mx/salud/documentos/informe-diario-del-brote-de-sarampion-en-mexico-2026. The edition used is the most recent one dated on or before 26 November 2026, where an edition's date is the date given in its own line "Información preliminar con fecha [date] de 2026, con corte a las 11:00 horas" (e.g. the edition dated 11 November 2026 stated 20,552 confirmed cases). If that PDF cannot be accessed, the figure reported for that same edition by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) is used.
question.fine_print: The value used is the combined 2025–2026 cumulative confirmed total (the 2025 and 2026 subtotals added together), not the 2026-only subtotal. Corrections or revisions appearing in bulletins dated after 26 November 2026 do not affect resolution.
